headline: Abu Dhabi's Ta'ziz Raises $1.39 Billion for Ruwais Projects
summary: Abu Dhabi's Ta'ziz has raised $1.39 billion to fund two major industrial projects in Ruwais, following previous multi-billion-dollar financing rounds.
why: Ta'ziz is a joint venture driving industrial and downstream chemical expansion in the United Arab Emirates to diversify energy revenues.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Substantial capital raising enables large-scale development in regional energy and industrial infrastructure projects.
